0.1.0.en: Initial release: local monitoring (Modbus TCP) and optional control (MQTT) for Weishaupt/Dimplex NWPM heat-pump gateways — no cloud required.

desc.en: Local data from Weishaupt/Dimplex heat pumps via the NWPM gateway (Modbus TCP for monitoring, MQTT for setpoints/modes). No cloud required.
